footer: This is a demo store: no real orders are shipped and no money is charged.
ignore: If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email.

verify.subject: Confirm your email
verify.heading: Confirm your email
verify.text: Thanks for creating an account. Confirm your email address to finish setting it up.

reset.subject: Reset your password
reset.heading: Reset your password
reset.text: We got a request to reset the password of your account. The link works for {hours, number, integer} hour and can be used once.

orderConfirmed.subject: Order #{number} confirmed
orderConfirmed.heading: Your order is confirmed
orderConfirmed.text: Thank you! We're getting order #{number} ready.
orderConfirmed.payCourier: Pay the courier {amount} when your order arrives.

shipped.subject: Order #{number} is on its way
shipped.heading: Your order has shipped
shipped.text: Order #{number} left our roastery and is on its way to you.

apology.subject: About your order #{number}
apology.heading: We're sorry, an item ran out
apology.text: While your payment was going through, an item in order #{number} sold out. We cancelled the order and refunded your payment in full.

backInStock.subject: Back in stock: {name}
backInStock.heading: It's back in stock
backInStock.text: {name} ({variant}) is available again. Stock is limited, so don't wait too long.
